title: fix(rest): security/explain refuses an empty object with 400 VALIDATION_FAILED instead of 500
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D2T3MYD69CaE3sEdpqrhNgW)_
Fixes #27719

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：管理员调用访问解释接口（`POST`/`GET /api/v1/security/explain`）时，`object` 传空字符串现在直接回 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`，不再回 500 `EXPLAIN_FAILED`。
- **为什么改**：这是调用方能自己改正的错误请求，却被当成服务器故障回给客户端、也按故障记日志；与上一张卡（空 `userId` 回 400）同一道门、同一种处理。
- **风险与回滚**：风险低——本来就失败的请求只是从 500 变成 400，合法请求一字节不变；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/rest/src/security-routes.ts`（`EMPTY_KEY_REMEDIES` 表与 handler 里那一个循环）、`packages/rest/src/security-routes.test.ts`（`[#27719]` 一组）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --project local src/security-routes.test.ts`，预期 22 个用例全部通过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`ExplainRequestSchema.object` is `z.string()`, so an empty `object` passed the schema, reached the explain engine, and the engine's plain `Error('[Security] explain: request.object is required')` fell to the route's catch-all `500 EXPLAIN_FAILED` arm.

The route now refuses it `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, in its own envelope and before any evaluation, through the check that already refused an empty `userId`. That check is now one table, `EMPTY_KEY_REMEDIES` (module-private, no export changes), with one row per key and the remedy its refusal names. The handler loops over it once, so the `userId` refusal is not copied. The `userId` message is byte-identical to before.

Per the triage ruling, the refusal is graded at the route. `packages/spec` is not touched. Moving both keys into `ExplainRequestSchema` (`min(1)`) is a separate spec narrowing that this PR does not grade.

Files: `packages/rest/src/security-routes.ts`, `packages/rest/src/security-routes.test.ts`, `.changeset/27719-explain-empty-object.md` (`@objectstack/rest` patch).

## Tests

New `[#27719]` block in `packages/rest/src/security-routes.test.ts`. Its fake service throws the engine's own plain error for an empty object:

- `POST` with `object: ""` gets 400, `success: false`, `error.code` `VALIDATION_FAILED`, and no verdict. The engine is never called.
- `GET ?object=` is refused the same way.
- A request that names an object is still explained, and the engine gets exactly the request it was sent (`POST` with `update`, and `GET` defaulting to `read`).

The `[#27442]` empty-`userId` block runs unchanged and passes.

Run on head `4f5150d8` (`objectstack-ai/objectstack`):

<details><summary>End to end: real showcase boot as the seed admin, through a throwaway dogfood probe that was not committed</summary>

```
main 9ae6384e:
POST object="" operation=read   status=500 {"success":false,"error":{"code":"EXPLAIN_FAILED","message":"[Security] explain: request.object is required"}}
GET ?object=&operation=read     status=500 (same body)
this branch 4f5150d8 (rest rebuilt):
POST object="" operation=read   status=400 {"success":false,"error":{"code":"VALIDATION_FAILED","message":"Invalid explain request — object is empty. Give the name of the object whose access to explain."}}
GET ?object=&operation=read     status=400 (same body)
controls, unchanged on both: POST object=showcase_task -> 200 allowed:true · POST userId="" -> 400 VALIDATION_FAILED (the userId message is byte-identical)
```
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The empty `object` refusal names its remedy ("Give the name of the object whose access to explain."). The test does not pin that wording: it asserts the code, the status, and that the engine was never called.
- A missing `object` (the key absent) is still refused by the request schema's own 400. This PR leaves it alone.

## Verification

Local subset on head `4f5150d8`: the gates derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` from 3 changed paths (+93 / -10), run one after another with each exit code captured before any pipe.

- Not run locally, and left to CI: `test:repo`, the full-tree `pnpm lint`, and the type-check lanes and path-scheduled jobs the derivation lists outside its total. No dogfood battery: the title has no `!` and the clause has no `(narrowing)` arm.
